---
title: "Exercise · Implement and test a capsule"
---

A short, guided exercise against the shared Greeting Capsule lab.
Complete the lab's [Steps 1–3](../../../../labs/greeting-capsule/walkthrough.html)
first so you have a validated `solution/capsule.yaml` and the
reference `solution/greeting.py` in place.

See the [Open Engineering Language Server (OELS) onboarding guide](../../../../oels.qmd)
for the local install and editor setup.

{{< include ../../../../shared/includes/oels.qmd >}}

## Tasks

Work from inside `labs/greeting-capsule/` in your local clone.

### Task 1 — Add a contract-test case the solution lacks

Open [`solution/tests/test_contract.py`](../../../../labs/greeting-capsule/solution/tests/test_contract.py).
The ContractTests class asserts the capability identifier, that each
declared-required input raises `MissingRequiredInput` when absent,
and that declared input/output names and types are honoured. It does
**not** assert the capsule's `apiVersion` and `kind` match the
upstream-adopted contract constants — a contract fact a learner
would want caught at test time.

Add one `unittest` method to `ContractTests` that reads the capsule
document and asserts `apiVersion == "open-engineering.io/v1alpha1"`
and `kind == "Capsule"`, matching the adopted upstream
[`capsule.schema.json`](https://github.com/open-engineering-capsules/source/blob/bf071c2c1b57/capsule.schema.json)
at commit `bf071c2c1b57`. For example:

```python
def test_apiversion_and_kind_match_adopted_upstream(self) -> None:
    self.assertEqual(self.capsule["apiVersion"], "open-engineering.io/v1alpha1")
    self.assertEqual(self.capsule["kind"], "Capsule")
```

Re-run the test suite:

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s solution/tests
```

Expected tail: `Ran 9 tests in 0.001s` / `OK`. The new case passes
without changing `greeting.py` because the capsule document already
carries the two adopted constants (lab Step 2).

### Task 2 — Break the contract deliberately and watch a test fail

Edit `solution/greeting.py` only — not `solution/capsule.yaml` — and
rename the returned output from `greeting` to `greet`:

```python
return {"greet": f"Hello, {value}!"}   # was: {"greeting": ...}
```

Re-run the suite:

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s solution/tests
```

Observe:

- `test_greeting.py :: test_returns_greeting_output` fails: the
  expected literal dict changed shape. (Unit test — specific
  behaviour drifted.)
- `test_contract.py :: test_declared_input_names_and_types_are_honoured`
  fails: `set(result.keys()) == {"greet"}` is not equal to the
  declared output set `{"greeting"}` read from `capsule.yaml`.

The second failure is the **contract test's job**: regardless of what
example value the implementation returns, the output *names* must
match what the capsule says it produces. A contract test derived at
test time from `capsule.yaml` catches this class of drift — a drive-by
rename, an accidental key change, a copy-paste — without re-encoding
the contract in Python assertions.

Revert the edit (`return {"greeting": ...}`) before continuing.

### Task 3 — Map a code change to the D2 breaking-change table

[memo2 §2 D2](https://github.com/open-engineering-capsules/source/blob/bf071c2c1b57/memo2.md#2-d2--version-compatibility-rule)
publishes the breaking-change table reproduced in
[Module 2 Lesson](../01-define-a-capsule/index.qmd#version-compatibility-constraints-memo2-2-d2).
Decide which row each of the following changes maps to and whether a
major, minor, or patch bump is required.

| Change (made to `capsule.yaml` and the matching code) | D2 row | Required bump |
|---|---|---|
| **A.** Rename the output `greeting` to `message` across capsule and code. | ? | ? |
| **B.** Add a new optional input `locale: {type: string}` (no `required: true`); the implementation returns the same output when `locale` is absent. | ? | ? |
| **C.** Add a new optional output `rendered_at: {type: string}` carrying an ISO-8601 timestamp. | ? | ? |
| **D.** Fix a typo in the one-line description above `spec.inputs:` — no field is added, removed, or renamed. | ? | ? |

## Worked answer

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Show worked answer"}
**Task 1.** The added method reads `self.capsule` set up in
`setUpClass` and asserts the two adopted constants. The suite now
reports `Ran 9 tests`.

**Task 2.** `test_returns_greeting_output` (unit) and
`test_declared_input_names_and_types_are_honoured` (contract) both
fail. The unit failure says *the specific example changed*. The
contract failure says *the implementation stopped honouring the names
the capsule declares* — the key check is
`set(result.keys()) == set(self.outputs.keys())` where the right-hand
set is read from `capsule.yaml`.

**Task 3.** Reading rows from
[memo2 §2 D2](https://github.com/open-engineering-capsules/source/blob/bf071c2c1b57/memo2.md#2-d2--version-compatibility-rule):

| Change | D2 row | Required bump |
|---|---|---|
| **A.** Rename output `greeting` → `message` | "Remove a declared `spec.outputs` entry" (the old name disappears; a new one appears). | **Breaking → major** |
| **B.** Add new optional input `locale` | "Add an optional `spec.inputs` entry (no `required: true`)" | **Compatible → minor** |
| **C.** Add new optional output `rendered_at` | "Add a new `spec.outputs` entry" | **Compatible → minor** |
| **D.** Fix a one-line description typo | "Documentation-only change" | **Compatible → patch** |

Row A is a reminder that *renaming* a declared output is a two-step
D2 change (remove old; add new) and therefore breaking: an existing
Pico that read the old key would stop finding it.
:::
